name: s30_surface_labels
caption: Hand labels of S3.0 step-1, last-quarter, and last-step text for local-gemma-3-1b-pt at W=256, 12 turnovers (run s3-local-base-20260901T184812Z-cc80633b). Reviewer register = self-review of the prompt ('you've provided', 'well-structured', 'comprehensive overview'). Silence = whitespace / recursion marks as in gemma-4-31b. Verbatim loop = a ≥40-character span repeats in the same completion. Token lock = a short repeated token or phrase that is not whitespace/recursion ('I I', 'Is This', '/1/1'). Continuation = none of those. Sliding seed-echo = last block is a rotation of the first. last_step uses the same criterion as last_quarter. 0/8 open in the reviewer register; 0/8 last-quarter silence; 8/8 degenerate by the last quarter.
alt_text: Hand labels of S3.0 step-1, last-quarter, and last-step text for local-gemma-3-1b-pt at W=256, 12 turnovers (run s3-local-base-20260901T184812Z-cc80633b). Reviewer register = self-review of the prompt ('you've provided', 'well-structured', 'comprehensive overview'). Silence = whitespace / recursion marks as in gemma-4-31b. Verbatim loop = a ≥40-character span repeats in the same completion. Token lock = a short repeated token or phrase that is not whitespace/recursion ('I I', 'Is This', '/1/1'). Continuation = none of those. Sliding seed-echo = last block is a rotation of the first. last_step uses the same criterion as last_quarter. 0/8 open in the reviewer register; 0/8 last-quarter silence; 8/8 degenerate by the last quarter.
limitations: Labels are a stated criterion applied to quoted text, not a classifier. The degeneracy threshold was calibrated at 1024-token chunks; S3.0 chunks are 256 tokens. 8/8 have n-gram repetition 0.84–0.98, so the calibration mismatch cannot flip the looping verdict. W=256 does not transfer to W=4096. T=0.3 physics s1 and s2 are bit-identical; effective independent n at that cell is 1, not 2.
